tasks.label: Build Windows EXE
tasks.command: Remove-Item *.class -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; javac *.java; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path input | Out-Null; jar --create --file input/HelloEXE.jar --main-class HelloEXE *.class; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force HelloEXE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; jpackage --input input --name HelloEXE --main-jar HelloEXE.jar --main-class HelloEXE --type app-image --icon icon.ico; Write-Host 'BUILD SUCCEEDED!' -ForegroundColor Green }
